name: ZN Intraday: NFP vs CPI Release Reaction
description: Compares ZN 10-year note intraday reaction to NFP vs CPI releases at 8:30 AM ET. Detects the 8:30 bar via datetime_extract, checks if it's an NFP or CPI day using common_economic_indicators, then measures forward returns at +5, +15, +30 minute bars. Reports a 2-row summary table (NFP/CPI) with avg absolute move and event count, a grouped bar chart comparing NFP vs CPI at each interval, and per-event markers with signed returns. Uses LiquidityBased rollover with BackwardRatio adjustment.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZN 10-YEAR NOTE: NFP vs CPI INTRADAY REACTION COMPARISON
# =============================================================================
# Both NFP and CPI release at 8:30 AM ET.
# Detect the 8:30 bar via datetime_extract (hour==8, minute==30).
# On that bar, check if NFP or CPI data is available (non-null → release day).
# Measure forward_returns at +5, +15, +30 bars from the 8:30 bar.
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# === 8:30 AM ET BAR DETECTION ===
bar_ts = index()
bar_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
bar_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
is_830 = (bar_hour == 8) and (bar_minute == 30)

# === NFP DAY DETECTION ===
nfp_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.NonfarmPayrolls)()
nfp_value = nfp_data.result
nfp_filled = ffill_day(nfp_value)
is_nfp_day = is_valid(nfp_filled)
is_nfp_830 = is_830 and is_nfp_day

# === CPI DAY DETECTION ===
cpi_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()
cpi_value = cpi_data.result
cpi_filled = ffill_day(cpi_value)
is_cpi_day = is_valid(cpi_filled)
is_cpi_830 = is_830 and is_cpi_day

# === FORWARD RETURNS FROM 8:30 BAR ===
fwd_5 = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_15 = forward_returns(period=15)(close)
fwd_30 = forward_returns(period=30)(close)

# === ABSOLUTE FORWARD RETURNS ===
abs_fwd_5 = abs(fwd_5)
abs_fwd_15 = abs(fwd_15)
abs_fwd_30 = abs(fwd_30)

# === NFP: SPARSE SERIES (non-null only on NFP 8:30 bars) ===
nfp_abs_5 = where(is_nfp_830, abs_fwd_5)
nfp_abs_15 = where(is_nfp_830, abs_fwd_15)
nfp_abs_30 = where(is_nfp_830, abs_fwd_30)

# === CPI: SPARSE SERIES (non-null only on CPI 8:30 bars) ===
cpi_abs_5 = where(is_cpi_830, abs_fwd_5)
cpi_abs_15 = where(is_cpi_830, abs_fwd_15)
cpi_abs_30 = where(is_cpi_830, abs_fwd_30)

# === SIGNED RETURNS FOR EVENT MARKERS ===
nfp_ret_5 = where(is_nfp_830, fwd_5)
nfp_ret_15 = where(is_nfp_830, fwd_15)
nfp_ret_30 = where(is_nfp_830, fwd_30)

cpi_ret_5 = where(is_cpi_830, fwd_5)
cpi_ret_15 = where(is_cpi_830, fwd_15)
cpi_ret_30 = where(is_cpi_830, fwd_30)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: NFP vs CPI, avg |move| at 5/15/30 min + event count ---
# Uses Count on the where-filtered series (non-null count = event count)
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZN Avg Absolute Move: NFP vs CPI (8:30 AM ET Release)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['NFP', 'CPI'],
        col_headers=['Avg |Move| 5min', 'Avg |Move| 15min', 'Avg |Move| 30min', 'Events'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='NFP vs CPI',
    order=0
)(nfp_abs_5, nfp_abs_15, nfp_abs_30, nfp_abs_5, cpi_abs_5, cpi_abs_15, cpi_abs_30, cpi_abs_5)

# --- Grouped Bar Chart: NFP vs CPI side by side at each time mark ---
# stack = x-axis category (5-Min, 15-Min, 30-Min)
# name = legend entry (NFP, CPI) — reused across stack groups
xy_bars(
    title='ZN Avg Absolute Move by Interval: NFP vs CPI',
    category='NFP vs CPI',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg |Return|',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='5-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Slate, stack='5-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='15-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Slate, stack='15-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='30-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Slate, stack='30-Min')
    ]),
    order=1
)(nfp_abs_5, cpi_abs_5, nfp_abs_15, cpi_abs_15, nfp_abs_30, cpi_abs_30)

# --- Event Marker: NFP Releases (signed returns) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='NFP Release',
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_nfp_830, nfp_ret_5, nfp_ret_15, nfp_ret_30)

# --- Event Marker: CPI Releases (signed returns) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='CPI Release',
        icon=Icon.PercentIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_cpi_830, cpi_ret_5, cpi_ret_15, cpi_ret_30)
